stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Who is last on the waiting list?

stations.title: The quay
stations.text: Names join and leave all morning

stations.title: Waiting list
stations.text: Grows and shrinks with the queue.

captions: The waiting list at the hut. Bridie wants the last name when the next boat is in.
On paper the list is crossed out and squeezed in, and an array cannot grow at all.
You write methods that make a list, read it, keep numbers in it and remove from it.
Now the list grows and shrinks with the queue, and the last name is always right.
ArrayList, Integer and for-each. Part 2 is done: the program repeats its work.
